name: Organizr
composeYaml:
services:
  organizr:
    image: 'organizr/organizr:latest'
    environment:
      - 'branch=${branch:-v2-master}'
    volumes:
      - 'organizr-data:/config'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'curl -sf http://localhost:80 || exit 1'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 1s
      retries: 3
